summary: WorldEntity's canonical ownership boundary does not currently enforce the project's StableId contract for entity/world/region identity. WorldEntity.isId accepts any non-empty control-free string up to 256 bytes, and origin.worldId/origin.regionId are only non-empty-string checked, so structurally valid records can be canonically owned with identities that ResolvedRegionRecipe and production PhysicsLab generation would reject or never emit.
evidence: Inspected main@ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1: WorldEntity.isId accepts any non-empty string <=256 bytes without control characters, while cloneOrigin applies only non-empty/control-character checks to worldId and optional regionId.

Docs/ARCHITECTURE.md states that WorldEntityId is supplied by the project StableId contract and that stable project-owned identity survives representation changes; the current WorldEntity boundary does not verify that invariant.

Core DeterminismContract.isStableId defines the canonical namespace:v<version>:<32-lowercase-hex> StableId shape. ResolvedRegionRecipe explicitly requires worldId to be a world StableId, derives regionId as a region StableId, and validates both on owned recipes.

Production PhysicsLabRecipe already constructs WORLD_ID with StableId.fromParts("world", ...), derives REGION_ID from ResolvedRegionRecipe, and constructs every entity id with StableId.fromParts("entity", ...), so current production generation follows the stricter identity model even though WorldEntity itself does not enforce it.

Retained WorldEntity generation-8 PR #429 closes aggregate canonical metadata string retention but explicitly leaves StableId/entity-id rules unchanged; this finding is therefore distinct from the metadata/count/diagnostic-budget repair lineage.

Existing WorldEntity tests deliberately use legacy human-readable pseudo IDs such as entity:0000000000000001 and world:0000000000000001. Tightening the boundary directly would therefore be a compatibility/test-contract migration, not a safe opportunistic source edit from capacity mining.
Repository PR/issue search found no active WorldEntity StableId-boundary repair. No source code, tests, Studio run, engine evidence, or schema migration was produced by this capacity-mining slot.

metadata.recommendedNext: After HG-BACKFILL-WORLDENTITY generation-8 ownership/review is resolved, make an explicit compatibility/versioning decision: either enforce canonical entity/world/region StableIds at WorldEntity ownership boundaries (with intentional migration of legacy tests/fixtures) or formally document which upstream boundary owns StableId verification and add integration regressions proving noncanonical IDs cannot become resolved/persistent truth. Do not change StableId v1 or add a second identity scheme.
